text: Sunday, November first, twelve fifty-one PM. A business jet struck this neighborhood in Palm Beach County, almost straight down.
asr: Sunday, Nov. 1, 1251 p.m. A business jet struck this neighborhood in Palm Beach County, almost straight down.

text: All nine people on board were killed.
The Learjet sixty had left Austin, Texas, for the Bahamas, cruising at thirty-five thousand feet.
asr: The Learjet 60 had left Austin, Texas, for the Bahamas, cruising at 35,000 feet.

text: Over South Florida, it flew into a line of thunderstorms.
At twelve forty-seven, the crew reported turbulence and icing, and asked to climb to thirty-seven thousand feet.
asr: At 1247, the crew reported turbulence and icing, and asked to climb to 37,000 feet.

text: Moments later, the jet began to dive.
The pilots reported an overspeed, a descent of twenty thousand feet a minute, and called mayday.
asr: The pilots reported an overspeed, a descent of 20,000 feet a minute and called May Day.

text: In about one minute, it fell from thirty-five thousand feet to under nine thousand.
asr: In about one minute, it fell from 35,000 feet to under 9,000.

text: It came down beside Military Trail. About six hundred residents were displaced.
asr: It came down beside Military Trail. About 600 residents were displaced.

text: Investigators see signs the jet may have begun breaking apart before impact.
The cause is not yet known. The N T S B hopes to recover the cockpit voice recorder.
asr: The cause is not yet known. The NTSB hopes to recover the cockpit voice recorder.
